title: MOTIF Studio — the complete tutorial

chapters.title: Start a project
chapters.narration: This is MOTIF Studio, a local first video editor. From the home screen you pick a name, a frame rate and a canvas, from landscape to vertical. Let's open the demo project, which MOTIF builds for you on the spot.

chapters.title: The workspace
chapters.narration: The workspace has four parts. Your media and tools on the left, the live preview in the middle, the inspector on the right, and a multitrack timeline at the bottom. Every panel is frosted glass and can be resized.

chapters.title: Timeline editing
chapters.narration: Press space to play. Press B for the blade and click to split a clip. Undo is always one shortcut away. Copy and paste, ripple delete, and freeze frame with the F key, which holds a frame and pushes the rest along.

chapters.title: Figma style canvas
chapters.narration: Select a layer right on the canvas. Drag to move it, and a live chip shows the exact position, just like in Figma. Snap guides lock it to the center, and handles let you scale and rotate.

chapters.title: Filters and color
chapters.narration: Open filters and apply a look in one click, like Noir or Vivid. Then fine tune brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature, blur and vignette in the Adjust tab.

chapters.title: Masks, chroma key and background
chapters.narration: In the Video tab you can crop and flip, fill empty space with a blurred background, cut the layer with a soft feathered mask, or remove a green screen with chroma key.

chapters.title: Animation, keyframes and transitions
chapters.narration: Animations bring layers in and out with fades, slides and zooms. Transitions blend two clips together, and every transform can be keyframed with easing, right from the inspector.

chapters.title: Text and titles
chapters.narration: The text panel has ready made styles. Add a neon title, then change the font, size, stroke, shadow and background box. Shapes work the same way.

chapters.title: Local AI: voice and captions
chapters.narration: Here is where it gets fun. Type a script and MOTIF turns it into a voice over, offline. Then auto captions transcribe it with Whisper, running on your own computer, with word level timing.

chapters.title: Audio and cleanup tools
chapters.narration: Audio clips get gain, fades, noise reduction and a voice changer. You can also extract audio from a video, stabilize shaky footage, and find and remove silences automatically.

chapters.title: Command palette
chapters.narration: Press control K to open the command palette. Every action in MOTIF is searchable, so you never have to hunt through menus.

chapters.title: Export up to 4K
chapters.narration: When you are ready, press control E. Choose any resolution up to 4K, frame rates up to sixty, and codecs like H 264, HEVC, AV1 and ProRes. You can also export a GIF, audio only, or a still frame.

chapters.title: MOTIF Cloud
chapters.narration: Finally, MOTIF Cloud is optional. Sign in, upload your project with its media, and every sync becomes a version you can restore. If two devices edit the same project, MOTIF asks you how to resolve it.

outro: Thanks for watching. MOTIF Studio is open source. Get it on GitHub.
